secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs listener and admin login sessions. Any long random string; Base44 stores it encrypted and it never reaches the repo.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client ID (type: Web application). Paste the client ID and add the app's origin under 'Authorized JavaScript origins'. Switches on the 'Sign in with Google' button; the API verifies the token with the same id.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys → Secret key (sk_test_… while testing). Switches on card checkout for Premium memberships and paid downloads.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → add endpoint <api origin>/api/payments/webhook for checkout.session.completed, then copy its signing secret (whsec_…). Optional: the back-from-checkout confirmation already grants access, this is the authoritative path for a real deployment.
